verdicts.title: Representations of the Rook-Brauer Algebra
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the representation theory of the rook-Brauer algebra RB_k(x), also called the partial Brauer algebra. This algebra has a basis of "rook-Brauer" diagrams, which are Brauer diagrams that allow for the possibility of missing edges. The Brauer, Temperley-Lieb, Motzkin, rook monoid, and symmetric group algebras are all subalgebras of the rook-Brauer algebra. verdicts.title: Brauer groups on K3 surfaces and arithmetic applications
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: For a prime $p$, we study subgroups of order p of the Brauer group Br(S) of a general complex polarized K3 surface of degree 2d, generalizing earlier work of van Geemen. These groups correspond to sublattices of index p of the transcendental lattice T_S of S; we classify these lattices up to isomorphism using Nikulin's discriminant form technique.
